entries.name: Convection
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Concussion
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Elemental Warding
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by $m1%.

entries.name: Reverberation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by ${$m1/-1000}.1 sec.

entries.name: Call of Flame
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Elemental Devastation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your offensive spell critical strikes will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by $m1% for $30165d.

entries.name: Elemental Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $h% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by $16246s1%.

entries.name: Elemental Alacrity
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by ${$m1/-1000}.2 sec.

entries.name: Improved Fire Nova
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by $m1% and reduces its cooldown by ${$m2/-1000} sec.

entries.name: Eye of the Storm
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by $m1%.

entries.name: Call of Thunder
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Elemental Reach
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by $m1 yards, and increases the range of your Flame Shock spell by $m2 yards.

entries.name: Lightning Overload
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a $m1% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

entries.name: Earthbound
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for $1238289d when cast.

entries.name: Elemental Fury
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Lava Burst
entries.descriptionTemplate: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing $s1 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals $s2% increased damage.

entries.name: Earth's Grasp
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by $m1% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by $m2%.

entries.name: Thundering Strikes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by $m1%.

entries.name: Ancestral Knowledge
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Intellect by $m1%.

entries.name: Guardian Totems
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by $m1% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by ${$m2/-1000} sec.

entries.name: Mental Dexterity
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to $m1% of your Intellect.

entries.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by ${$m1/-1000}.1 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

entries.name: Improved Lightning Shield
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by $m1%.

entries.name: Elemental Weapons
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by $m1%, your Windfury Weapon effect by $m3% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by $m2%.

entries.name: Shamanistic Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Anticipation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional $m1%.

entries.name: Toughness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Stamina by $m1%.

entries.name: Flurry
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your attack speed by $m1% for your next $16257n swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

entries.name: Stormstrike
entries.descriptionTemplate: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by $s2% for $d.

entries.name: Spirit Weapons
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by $s1% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by $s3% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

entries.name: Mental Quickness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to $m2% of your Intellect.

entries.name: Improved Stormstrike
entries.descriptionTemplate: When you Stormstrike, you have a $m1% chance to gain $1238931s1% mana regeneration while casting spells for $1238931d, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a $m2% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

entries.name: Maelstrom Weapon
entries.descriptionTemplate: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by $m1%. Stacks up to $s3 times. Lasts $408505d.

entries.name: Rage of the Farseer
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your attack speed by $s1% for $d.

entries.name: Improved Healing Wave
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by ${$m1/-1000}.1 sec.

entries.name: Totemic Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by $m1%.

entries.name: Mindfulness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Allows $m1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Natural Grace
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Tidal Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by $m1% and improves your chance to hit by $m2%.

entries.name: Improved Reincarnation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by ${$m1/-60000} min, increases your maximum health by $m2%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional $m3%.

entries.name: Ancestral Healing
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your target's armor value by $m1% for $16177d after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

entries.name: Healing Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

entries.name: Water Shield
entries.descriptionTemplate:
The caster is surrounded by $n globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, $408511s1% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds.  Lasts $d.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

entries.name: Tidal Mastery
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Restorative Totems
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by $m1% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by $m2%.

entries.name: Mana Tide Totem
entries.descriptionTemplate: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with $s1 health at the feet of the caster for ${$d-1} sec that restores $16191s1 mana every $16191t1 seconds to group members within $16191a1 yards.

entries.name: Healing Way
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by $m1%.

entries.name: Nature's Swiftness
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

entries.name: Purification
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Riptide
entries.descriptionTemplate: Heals a friendly target for $s1, an additional $o2 over $d, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by $s3%.
